[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > Footnotes] 2016 anaw 1 . Section 257 makes provision about commencement. Part 11 of the Act came into force the day after the day on which the Act received Royal Assent (19 January 2016). Certain other provisions of the Act were brought into force by S.I. 2016/813 for the purpose of making Regulations and issuing Guidance. The Welsh Government has announced that the remaining provisions of the Act are to come into force on 1st December 2022.
